prompt:
A realistic full-body photograph of a young South Asian woman leaning casually against a white wall. She has dark brown hair tied in a low messy bun with soft strands framing her face, warm medium skin tone, and a bright cheerful smile. She is wearing an oversized black button-down shirt with sleeves rolled up over a plain white crew-neck t-shirt, paired with black skinny jeans. Her right hand is raised making the ‘rock on’ hand gesture (index and pinky fingers extended), left hand resting behind her head. Soft warm lighting with out-of-focus bokeh lights visible in a dark hallway on the right. Clean studio composition, high detail, photorealistic.

To her left on the white wall is a large black-and-white line-art cartoon illustration of the same woman in a matching pose: right hand making the ‘rock on’ gesture, smiling, with the bold handwritten text “ROCK STAR!” above her head, plus several star shapes and sparkles around her. The cartoon figure has the same hairstyle, open shirt over t-shirt, and jeans, drawn in a clean modern cartoon style with bold outlines and motion lines.

Vertical portrait orientation, natural colors, sharp focus on the real woman, artistic contrast between photorealism and line art.

promptZh:
一张写实的全身照片，主体为 一位靠在白墙上姿态随意的南亚年轻女性。她留着 深棕色头发，扎成低位凌乱发髻，几缕发丝轻柔地修饰着脸庞，肤色温暖适中，笑容灿烂明媚。她穿着 一件超大号黑色衬衫，袖子卷起，内搭纯白色圆领 T 恤，下身搭配黑色紧身牛仔裤。她的右手举起做出“摇滚”手势（食指和小指伸出），左手放在脑后。柔和的暖光，右侧昏暗的走廊中可见失焦的焦外成像光斑。干净的摄影棚构图，高细节，照片级真实感。

在她左侧的白墙上，是一幅巨大的黑白线条卡通插画，画中的她摆着同样的姿势：右手做出“摇滚”手势，面带微笑，头顶上方有醒目的手写文字“ROCK STAR!”，周围环绕着几颗星星和闪光图案。卡通形象拥有相同的发型、外搭衬衫配 T 恤以及牛仔裤，采用简洁的现代卡通风格绘制，线条粗犷且带有动感线条。

竖向肖像构图，自然色彩，焦点清晰地聚焦在真人女性身上，展现出照片写实主义与线条艺术之间的艺术对比。
